2026 CONTRACT RATES/KENYA/ACCOMODATION/MANZILI HOUSE/REVISED Manzili MARA - STO Rates 2026.pdf

validity.raw: Rack Rates valid: 1st June 2025 - 15th January 2027 (both Rack and STO files state the same window)

notes: Sits in the MANZILI HOUSE folder but is a distinct property from Manzili House (Nairobi-area guesthouse) - Manzili Mara is a Maasai Mara camp/villa with ensuite rooms (2 suites, 3 standard rooms, max 10 pax).
Two seasons only: Green Season (16 Jan-31 May, 1 Oct-15 Dec) and Premium Season (1 Jun-30 Sep, 16 Dec 2026-15 Jan).

STO tier discount confirmed arithmetically: STO = Rack x 0.80 exactly on every line (e.g. Exclusive Use Green $4,000 = $5,000 x 0.8; Premium $5,280 = $6,600 x 0.8; Suite pppn $1,200 = $1,500 x 0.8; Standard pppn $800 = $1,000 x 0.8; child $320 = $400 x 0.8). STO 20% tier.
Full board meal plan included; drinks (soft drinks, house wine, non-luxury spirits) included; champagne/premium wines & spirits excluded.
Single supplement US$300 charged only when a single guest travels SOLO (no supplement when travelling with a group) - not stated whether this is a per-night or per-stay figure.

roomCategories.unit: per adult per night, on top of Exclusive Use rate
per person per night, max 2 bookings taken when non-exclusive

maasaiMaraReserveFee.confidenceNote: Excluded from the quoted room rate (listed under 'EXCLUDED' along with Mara Triangle/Mara Reserve fees).

inclusions: Soft drinks, house wines & non-luxury spirits
Airstrip transfers & use of private vehicle/driver
exclusions: Gratuities, items of a personal nature

specialOffers.raw: Green Season Special: Stay 3 nights / Pay 2 (Park Fees still applicable). Minimum 2 night stay overall.

policies.deposit: 20% non-refundable deposit to confirm booking, balance due 60 days prior to arrival
policies.cancellation: >60 days: 20% charge; 45-60 days: 50% charge; 30-44 days: 75% charge; <=29 days: 100% charge
policies.singleSupplement: US$300, only when travelling solo (waived when travelling with a group)
